subject: The slider you haven't touched yet
preview_text: Most users never find this feature. It's the reason we built the whole app.
body_paragraphs: You downloaded Volume Booster Pro. Liked the boost. Hated the ads in the free version. So you switched. I get it.
But there's a panel you've probably ignored. It's at the bottom of the single screen — the one with the slider and nothing else. Most people never tap it. They just crank the volume and move on.

That panel is the equalizer. It's not a gimmick. It's a quiet way to shape every sound that hits your ears — more bass for podcasts, less treble for late-night YouTube, a flat curve for Spotify. No pop-ups. No setup. Just a slider that stays out of your way until you want it.

Open the app. Tap the bottom panel once. Slide the 60Hz band up by two notches. That's it. Close the app. You'll hear the difference on your next headphone connect. P.S. — This same EQ is what Premium users call the 'secret weapon' for making cheap earbuds sound like $200 ones.
